default/31339.htm.text: Amulet Seller Hakran: When I first arrived, I was shocked to see so much information stored here. Between you and me, I think Humans must write everything down to compensate for their bad memories! Seriously, though, it makes me realize that there is so much for young Orcs to learn in this world. Y…

Q00076_SagaOfTheGrandKhavatari/0-01.htm.text: Amulet Seller Hakran: We've got a big problem! Do you remember Hubai, Khavatari's eldest son? He knows more about the arts of Khavatari than anyone!

Q00076_SagaOfTheGrandKhavatari/0-04.htm.text: Amulet Seller Hakran: Visit the Duda-Mara totem spirit. He's laid out webs everywhere. He should know by now which way they're headed..!

Q00076_SagaOfTheGrandKhavatari/0-06.htm.text: Amulet Seller Hakran: Kashu has returned to the village. But you have more business to do, don't you? From now on, Khavatari Hubai's job will be done by Khavatari Kashu. He asked me to relay his gratitude for avenging Hubai's death. Have you completed your pilgrimage of the vision?

Q00076_SagaOfTheGrandKhavatari/0-09.htm.text: Amulet Seller Hakran: Are you well-rested? If you''ve completed your pilgrimage of the vision, today you are a Grand Khavatari! Not many have completed that pilgrimage! I pray that you and Kashu further develop the arts of Khavatari. Tejakar Khavatari!

Q00076_SagaOfTheGrandKhavatari/0-010.htm.text: Amulet Seller Hakran: When your wounds have healed and your body has recovered, come back and see me. I need to tell you something. (Only a character of level 76 or above may transfer to another class. Don't abandon the quest until class transfer is complete.)
when: cond 20; NOT level >= 76; !((npcId == 31339) && st.isCompleted()); player.getClassId().getId() == getPrevClass(player)

Q00076_SagaOfTheGrandKhavatari/0-02.htm.text: Amulet Seller Hakran: I probably should even mention the temple's disgrace to you! You're bound to find out eventually...? But I don't want to unnecessarily alarm you! Train more...! For now, just prepare for disaster...! (Quest available for Tyrants of Level 76 or above only.)

Q00076_SagaOfTheGrandKhavatari/0-03.htm.text: Amulet Seller Hakran: He was assassinated.....! You're the most accomplished tyrant I've ever seen! I'll wager you could track down that scoundrel...! Take this. It's one of three of the Khavatari scrolls left by Hubai! The other two are missing, and Khavatari Kashu and Khavatari Urzu, Hubai's disc…

Q00076_SagaOfTheGrandKhavatari/0-05.htm.text: Amulet Seller Hakran: Exactly! Your old trainer, Khavatari Rosheek, and Khavatari Toruku are disciples of Khavatari Hubai. Such a pity about what happened to Hubai...!

Q00076_SagaOfTheGrandKhavatari/0-07.htm.text: Amulet Seller Hakran: Very well. As of today, you've officially become Grand Khavatari! This is a reason to celebrate! Grand Khavataris have appeared at the same time! Yes, we've lost Hubai... but our future no longer seems so bleak!

Q00076_SagaOfTheGrandKhavatari/0-08.htm.text: Amulet Seller Hakran: Wonderful! Go rest for a while and then come back and see me. I have something tell you after you recover your strength. (Only a character of level 76 or above can transfer to another class. Don't abandon this quest until class transfer is complete.)
